note: One product per series-2 layer (product_id = layer id). 'start'/'end' are the prepared record at registration; the store serves the bounds of the delivered data. 'approved' order lives in concepts.json.

products.agency: NASA (GPM mission; distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Surface precipitation rate (rain and snow) from the merged multi-satellite estimate, calibrated with monthly gauge analyses over land.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Satellite retrievals are less reliable over snow and ice, at high latitudes and for light or orographic precipitation.
The record before the GPM launch (2014) relies on the TRMM-era constellation; sensor changes can affect long-term homogeneity.
Monthly means cannot resolve individual rain events.

products.agency: GPCP (produced at the University of Maryland; distributed by NOAA PSL)
products.physical_definition: Surface precipitation rate from the merged satellite–gauge monthly analysis.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: The 2.5° native grid is much coarser than most regions; small regions inherit the value of one or two native cells.
Not a NASA portal product: distributed by NOAA PSL.
Monthly means cannot resolve individual rain events.
products.caveat: GPCP is distributed by NOAA PSL (not a NASA portal).
products.caveat_zh: GPCP 由 NOAA PSL 發布（非 NASA 入口）

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Surface precipitation rate from the MERRA-2 reanalysis after its observation-based precipitation correction.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Changes in the assimilated observing system can introduce artificial shifts in reanalysis time series.
Monthly means cannot resolve individual rain events.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Precipitation rate seen by the land surface model of MERRA-2 (land tiles only).
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Registered for inspection only: same model as p_m2 with a shorter prepared record (from 2000) and delivered only for regions that also have p_m2, so it can never be needed as a fallback.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Total evaporation from the surface (soil evaporation, transpiration, interception loss, sublimation) of the MERRA-2 reanalysis.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Grid-cell total: in coastal and lake cells it includes open-water evaporation, unlike the land-only products.
Evapotranspiration is not assimilated; it depends on the model's land surface and forcing.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Evapotranspiration from the land tiles of the MERRA-2 land surface model.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Land tiles only; differs from et_m2 where a region contains open water.
Prepared record starts in 2000.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Evapotranspiration of the Noah land surface model in GLDAS-2.1.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Known drift in the long-term trend of GLDAS-2.1 evapotranspiration (team finding W11); it is the last fallback for that reason.
GLDAS-2.1 forcing sources change during the record.
products.caveat: GLDAS-2.1 evapotranspiration has a known drift in its long-term trend (team finding W11).
products.caveat_zh: GLDAS-2.1 蒸散長期趨勢有已知漂移（隊友 FINDINGS W11）

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Potential evapotranspiration diagnosed by the Noah land surface model (evaporation that the atmosphere would take from a well-watered surface).
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Known drift in the long-term trend of GLDAS-2.1 potential evapotranspiration.
Model-specific formulation; not interchangeable with reference-crop or pan evaporation.
products.caveat: GLDAS-2.1 potential evapotranspiration has a known drift in its long-term trend.
products.caveat_zh: GLDAS-2.1 潛在蒸散趨勢有已知漂移

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Water stored in the root zone of the Noah model (depth depends on the model's vegetation class).
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Absolute values depend on model soil parameters; anomalies and trends are more meaningful than levels.
No irrigation or groundwater in the model.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Water stored in the four Noah soil layers down to 2 m.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Absolute values depend on model soil parameters.
No irrigation or groundwater in the model.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Water stored in the top Noah soil layer (0–10 cm).
products.prepared_resolution: regional mean of the GLDAS 1° product (separate upstream export), monthly
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Prepared from the 1° product: coarser than the other GLDAS layers.
The surface layer responds within days; a monthly mean smooths that variability.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Degree of saturation (0–1) of the root zone in the MERRA-2 land surface model.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
A dimensionless degree of saturation: it cannot be converted to millimetres of water without the model's soil parameters, so it is not a fallback for the GLDAS storage products.

products.agency: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (distributed by NASA PO.DAAC)
products.product_name: GRACE / GRACE-FO JPL mascon terrestrial water storage anomaly
products.version: release not recorded in the export-2 hand-off
products.physical_definition: Anomaly of total water mass (groundwater, soil moisture, snow, ice, surface water) as equivalent water height, relative to the product's own 2004.0–2009.999 time mean.
products.native_resolution: 3° spherical-cap mascons, sampled on a 0.5° grid; monthly solutions
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Effective resolution is about 300 km: regions smaller than about 200,000 km² mix in signal from their surroundings (the region catalogue carries a warning for such regions).
Missing months: early mission months, battery-management gaps from 2011, and the gap between GRACE and GRACE-FO (2017-07 to 2018-05). They are null and are never interpolated.
Large earthquakes cause gravity jumps that are not hydrological.
A glacial isostatic adjustment model is removed upstream; its error is largest over formerly glaciated regions.
The anomaly cannot be separated into groundwater, soil moisture, snow or surface water without other data.
products.caveat: Effective resolution of GRACE is about 300 km; large earthquakes cause non-hydrological gravity jumps.
products.caveat_zh: GRACE 有效解析度約 300 km；大地震會造成非水文的重力跳動

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Total runoff generated by the Noah land surface model (surface plus subsurface), as a grid-cell flux.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
Runoff generation, not river discharge: no routing, reservoirs, withdrawals or gauges.
The export-2 hand-off does not record the component fields or formula used upstream.
Levels differ strongly between land surface models.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Overland runoff plus baseflow of the MERRA-2 land surface model, as a grid-cell flux.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Runoff generation, not river discharge: no routing, reservoirs, withdrawals or gauges.
Levels differ strongly between land surface models.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Water equivalent of the snowpack simulated by the Noah land surface model.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.

GLDAS has no glacier or ice-sheet model: where snow never melts the simulated snowpack keeps accumulating (values of tens of metres occur in this export). Do not interpret this product over ice sheets, glaciers or permanent snow.
Mostly zero outside the snow season and in snow-free regions.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Near-surface air temperature of the GLDAS-2.1 meteorological forcing.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: A forcing field derived from atmospheric analyses, not a station record.
GLDAS-2.1 forcing sources change during the record.
Converted upstream from K to °C.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Surface (skin) temperature of the land, including snow, in the MERRA-2 land surface model; all-sky, all hours.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
A skin temperature: it differs from air temperature and from a clear-sky daytime satellite retrieval.
Converted upstream from K to °C.

products.agency: NASA (MODIS; distributed by NASA LP DAAC)
products.version: collection not recorded in the export-2 hand-off
products.physical_definition: Clear-sky land surface (skin) temperature retrieved at the Terra daytime overpass.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Terra's orbit has drifted to an earlier overpass time since 2020, which produces a spurious cooling trend (team finding W6). Trends that include years after 2020 must be read with this caveat.
Clear-sky only: cloudy days are not sampled.
A daytime skin temperature at one overpass time; not air temperature and not a daily mean.
products.caveat: MODIS Terra orbit drift after 2020 causes a spurious cooling trend (team finding W6).
products.caveat_zh: MODIS Terra 2020 年後軌道漂移，會造成假的降溫趨勢（隊友 FINDINGS W6）

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.product_name: Vapour pressure deficit computed from GLDAS forcing
products.physical_definition: Saturation vapour pressure at air temperature minus actual vapour pressure near the surface, computed upstream from the GLDAS forcing fields.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Computed upstream from forcing temperature, humidity and pressure. The export-2 hand-off does not record the component fields or formula used upstream.
Computed from monthly fields, so it is not the mean of sub-daily vapour pressure deficit.
GLDAS-2.1 forcing sources change during the record.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Net radiation at the land surface (net shortwave plus net longwave) of the Noah model.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Land-surface model output (Noah driven by observation-based forcing); not a direct observation.
The export-2 hand-off does not record the component fields or formula used upstream.
Depends on model albedo and surface temperature.

products.agency: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Net shortwave plus net longwave radiation at the land surface in the MERRA-2 land surface model.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: Reanalysis model output; not a direct observation.
Depends on model clouds, albedo and surface temperature.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Downward shortwave (solar) radiation at the surface in the GLDAS-2.1 forcing.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: A forcing field from analyses and satellite-based radiation, not a surface radiometer record.
GLDAS-2.1 forcing sources change during the record, which can affect trends.

products.agency: NASA GSFC Hydrological Sciences Laboratory (distributed by NASA GES DISC)
products.physical_definition: Near-surface wind speed of the GLDAS-2.1 forcing (speed only, no direction).
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: A forcing field derived from atmospheric analyses, not an anemometer record.
Speed only: no wind direction, so circulation changes cannot be inferred.
GLDAS-2.1 forcing sources change during the record.

products.agency: NASA (MODIS; distributed by NASA LP DAAC)
products.version: collection and platform not recorded in the export-2 hand-off
products.physical_definition: Normalised difference vegetation index, (NIR − red) / (NIR + red), from MODIS surface reflectance composites.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: A greenness index, not biomass, productivity or vegetation health.
Saturates over dense canopies; affected by snow, cloud, aerosol and soil background.
High-latitude regions have missing winter months (no sunlight or snow); those months are null.
Sensor ageing and orbit drift of the platform can affect long-term trends.

products.agency: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
products.product_name: NOAA OISST (monthly mean of the daily analysis)
products.physical_definition: Sea surface temperature from the daily optimum-interpolation blend of satellite, ship, buoy and Argo observations.
products.prepared_resolution: 0.5° monthly grid prepared upstream (hub), area-averaged over the region; a series is delivered only where at least 30% of the region has valid data
quality_limits: A NOAA product, not a NASA product.
Delivered for ocean regions only.
Sea-ice covered months are missing or constrained by an ice-to-temperature relation in the source analysis.
Monthly means cannot resolve marine heatwave events, which are defined on daily data.
